properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 9:29PM MDT until August 15 at 12:30AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Logan County in northeastern Colorado...
Western Phillips County in northeastern Colorado...
Sedgwick County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 1230 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 929 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This may cause small
stream flooding. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Patent Creek, Wildhorse Creek, Spring Creek, Lodgepole Creek,
Sandy Creek, West Fork Cottonwood Creek, Sand Creek, North Fork
Frenchman Creek and South Platte River. Additional rainfall
amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the area. This additional
rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Julesburg, Haxtun, Ovid, Sedgwick, Crook, Paoli, Marks Butte,
Fairfield, Twin Buttes, Highland Center and Dailey.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 9:03PM MDT until August 15 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall over Bijou Creek is
expected.

* WHERE...Northern Elbert County in east central Colorado...
Central Adams County in northeastern Colorado...
Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...
Southwestern Morgan County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 900 PM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding along Bijou Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 858 PM MDT, Up to five inches of heavy rainfall fell on
Friday evening. Elevated creek waters are expected to cause minor
flooding along Bijou Creek over the next 15 to 18 hours as the
water makes its way north to the South Platte River.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
West Bijou Creek and Bijou Creek.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Hoyt and Byers.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 8:58PM MDT until August 15 at 3:00AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding due to excessive rainfall will persist over the
next several hours after 3 to 5 inches of rainfall was observed
this evening.

* WHERE...Central Elbert County in east central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 300 AM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas will
continue.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 853 PM MDT, Between 3 to 5 inches of heavy rainfall fell
this evening. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to persist in
the advisory area for the next several hours.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Comanche Creek, Hay Gulch, Spring Branch, Wilson Creek, East
Bijou Creek, Antelope Creek, West Bijou Creek and Middle Bijou
Creek.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Central Elbert County.
